title: Nokia Ruled Smartphones. Then Apple Ended It
source: Nokia smartphone shipments and Apple iPhone fiscal-year unit sales compiled from IDC, Gartner, Strategy Analytics, and company reports. Nokia shipped about 100 million smartphones in 2010; its share halved from 33% in 2010 to 16% in 2011 and shipments fell to roughly 30-35 million by 2012-2013. Apple iPhone unit sales are from Apple 10-K filings. Figures are approximate and rounded to the nearest million.
